items.author: obcycler.bsky.social
items.context: 💯 I remember paying $30 for a new DOS game in 1994. At a time when you didn't even know if the game would crash because it didn't like your combination of sound card and motherboard 😂
items.text: Picking the right IRQ and port in the sound card setup menu was a rite of passage back then.

items.author: interleave.bsky.social
items.context: Forgotten? I've got a Packard Bell Legend Supreme 1810 running Windows 95 and DOS and a Compaq Presario running Windows 98. :-) - I keep them for the games. lol
items.text: Keeping the original hardware for the games is the purest way to play them. Great setup!
